newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank/Greece drains 250 bln drs at avge 11.88 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Greece drains 250 bln drs at avge 11.88 pct.

text.p: Bank of Greece drained 250 billion drachmas of 14-day depo funds at an average rate of 11.88 percent in today's tender, it said in a statement.
The minimum accepted interest rate was 11.79 percent and the maximum interest rate was 11.90 percent.
Last week's tender of 14-day funds for 200 billion drachmas produced an average interest rate of 11.89 percent. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
